title: docs: fix typos and grammatical errors across man pages
body:
### Description

There are several typos and grammatical issues across the documentation man pages in the `docs/` directory:

1. **`docs/buildah-images.1.md`**:
   - Line 36: `"An images is considered to be dangling..."` → should be `"An image is considered to be dangling..."`
   - Line 42: `"An images is considered to be an indermediate image..."` → contains both grammatical error (`An images`) and spelling typo (`indermediate` → `intermediate`).
   - Line 45: `"Filter by images labels key and/or value."` → should be `"Filter by image labels key and/or value."`

2. **`docs/buildah-push.1.md`**:
   - Line 11: `"... decompressing and recompessing layers as needed."` → contains spelling typo (`recompessing` → `recompressing`).

3. **`docs/buildah-source-add.1.md`**:
   - Line 10: `"Add add a source artifact to a source image."` → contains duplicated word (`Add add` → `Add a source artifact`).

### Steps to Reproduce
Check the man pages in `docs/buildah-images.1.md`, `docs/buildah-push.1.md`, and `docs/buildah-source-add.1.md`.

### Expected Results
Man pages and documentation are free of typos and grammatical mistakes.

### Actual Results
Typos such as `indermediate`, `recompessing`, `Add add`, and `An images` are present in the documentation.
